title: Cloud City: High Availability by Layer: Compute, Network, Storage & Database

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: A transformer explosion at the central power plant plunged the entire metropolitan transit, hospital, and water systems into darkness.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: City Planner Nora divided the city into three independent power districts connected by automated cross-tie switches.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When Substation B flooded, Substation A and C automatically doubled their output, keeping hospitals and traffic lights running seamlessly.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: High-voltage city grid switching takes mechanical relays and minutes; software-defined cloud routing balances load in seconds.
